g.text: so future, you ready for some hot off the presses fables & frontiers action
Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo6.
you'll come back, i know it
“As you turn the key given to you by a surprisingly cordial gang of oversized rats, you pray that whatever is beyond the door is better than the dungeon that lay behind you.”
Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo3.
Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo2.
“You find yourself in front of a large service elevator. This is no mere dungeon?”
“You turn around and look at the dungeon, thinking to yourself ‘going back in there is a dumb idea.’”
“You ride the elevator up. Through its open cage you can see the stone walls of the dungeon being replaced by more and more advanced technology. You wonder again, ‘where the hell am I?’”
“The elevator exits into a hall of gurgling machines, and giant tubes. Is this some sort of laboratory?”
From a room down the hall, you hear a man crying out in pain.
Ignore the cries, find a way out.
"You search around the hall for anything of value, but the cries become impossible to ignore. You are drawn to this man and must help him."

“You walk down the hall following the source of the agonizing screams. You enter a large mechanical room, there you see a man. A not unattractive man, who is strapped to a machine. Bolts of electricity dance out of his fingers feeding a giant turbine.”

"The man is strapped to a raised platform, arms splayed out. Attached to his fingertips are probes that twist together into a heavy gauge cable that lead to a giant turbine. Arcs of electricity dance nimbly from his hands."
Between cries and zaps the man manages to say, "STOP... THE... TURBINES!!"
"You look around the room for something useful. You see a bench with tools. A crowbar. Giant wirecutters. A control panel."
"You pick up the hefty crowbar, it's a solid tool. The muffled cries from the man grow more intense."
i'm gonna have to stop you before you give me carpal tunnel or something
"The wire cutters are industrial strength, and look like they could cut through just about anything."
Use the crowbar to smash the control panel.
Toss the crowbar into the turbine blades.
this is either abuse or you're REEAAAAAAAALLY bad at this
"You probably don't want to mess with that again."
"You try to use the control panel but it’s locked behind a security protocol that even you can’t hack. You realize you're going to have to do this manually."
"With a might thrust you toss the crowbar into the turbine. A massive cacophony of grinding gears and pistons fills the room. As the turbine's spin slows to a crawl."
"The man slumps down in relief. Get me out of here."
"The wire cutters make quick work of the cables attached to the man. With his arms free, he is able to remove his restraints."
"You place the blade of the wirecutters on the arcing wires and immediately regret it. The current flows through the wire cutters into your body sending you flying back."
"That didn't work so well last time."
"As you smash the control panel, the trapped man seems to scream at you. He did not like that you did that."
"Removing his circular sunglasses, the man takes a long look at his saviour."
"You come to on the floor. The man is still in pain and your hair now stands straight up."
"Miraculously, somehow, the turbine EXPLODES under the force of the man's sheer power!"
"Removing his circular glasses, the man takes a long look at his savior."
"You notice his strong hands, ample foreams, and wirery legs. 'Built for speed' you think with eyebrows raised."
"Removing his circular glasses, the man takes a long look at the person who was trying to save him."
Settle down there big guy. What's this handsome man's name?
Sounds familiar. What were they doing to you?
"'Harvesting me for my energy. I'm very electric, but you probably noticed that already.' Zabir says."
Okay, Zabir, how do we save the Lotus.
Zabir is shocked. "Save the Lotus? She's the one who put me here! We need to get off this asteroid!"
that's what i call a plot twist. bam.
sol if i know. gotta figure that out
Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo8.
